text: Rosstat classifies AO 'Obl-TV' — the company behind Chelyabinsk's OTV channel — as 'property of subjects of the Russian Federation' (owned by a region).

source.name: Checko — AO 'OBL-TV' (EGRUL/Rosstat codes)
source.note: Russian; Rosstat ownership-form code OKFS 13 'Property of subjects of the Russian Federation'. The same page: the company was created on 4 May 2018 'by reorganisation (transformation)' of the state enterprise of Chelyabinsk Oblast 'Oblastnoye Televideniye'. No publication dateline; the page states 'As of 3 October 2026 the company is active' (na 3 oktyabrya 2026 goda).

additionalSources.name: Datanewton — AO "OBL-TV" (company summary, EGRUL data)
additionalSources.note: Russian; 'State enterprise of Chelyabinsk Oblast Oblastnoye Televideniye' — listed as the predecessor (pravopredshestvennik) of AO 'Obl-TV', registered 4 May 2018. Second publisher corroborating the register data behind this claim; the page itself is undated (service footer (c) 2026).
